meta.name: alterlab-biopython
meta.description: Manipulate biological sequences, parse FASTA/GenBank/PDB files, run phylogenetics, and access NCBI/PubMed programmatically via Biopython (Bio.SeqIO, Bio.Entrez, Bio.PDB, Bio.Blast). Use when scripting custom bioinformatics pipelines, batch-processing sequence files, automating BLAST, or fetching records from Entrez — for quick one-off database lookups use gget, for unified multi-service integration use bioservices. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 用 Biopython 处理生物序列、解析文件、运行系统发育分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Python 脚本处理生物序列或访问 NCBI 数据库
copy.tagline_en: Process biological sequences, parse files, and run phylogenetics with Biopython
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Python scripts to handle biological sequences or access NCBI databases

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能用 Biopython 处理生物序列、解析 FASTA/GenBank/PDB 文件、运行系统发育分析，并通过 Entrez 访问 NCBI 数据库。
howto.when: 当你要求处理 DNA/RNA/蛋白质序列、读写生物文件格式、运行 BLAST 搜索、或从 NCBI 获取数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Biopython 读取这个 FASTA 文件并计算 GC 含量。
say.note: Claude 会解析文件并输出每条序列的 GC 百分比。

say.text: 从 GenBank 下载序列 EU490707 并显示其描述。
say.note: Claude 会通过 Entrez 获取记录并打印信息。

say.text: 用 BLAST 搜索这段序列，返回前 5 个匹配。
say.note: Claude 会运行 BLAST 并列出头部结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manipulate biological sequences, parse FASTA/GenBank/PDB files, run phylogenetics, and access NCBI databases via Biopython.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to process DNA/RNA/protein sequences, read/write bio file formats, run BLAST searches, or fetch data from NCBI.

say_en.text: Read this FASTA file and calculate GC content using Biopython.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the file and output GC percentages.

say_en.text: Download sequence EU490707 from GenBank and show its description.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the record via Entrez and print info.

say_en.text: BLAST this sequence and return the top 5 hits.
say_en.note: Claude will run BLAST and list top results.
